meta.name: compose-creator-layer
meta.description: Composite a generated creator track into a product layer, per beat — in the creator's zone on split beats (either side of a seam), full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats — with the creator's voice as the audio (loudness -14 LUFS) and an optional ducked music bed, or a music-only or silent master for voiceless formats. Free, local ffmpeg. Pairs with footage-cutlist (the layer) and create-creator-takes-h3 (the creator). Use for split-screen, screen-insert and any creator-over-product format.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把创作者画面按节拍合成进产品视频,自动做分屏与全屏,输出带配音或配乐的成片
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要做创作者出镜或分屏形式的产品视频并想在本地直接合成
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you make creator-over-product videos and want to composite them locally

howto.what: 它按节拍把创作者片段合进产品画面层:分屏节拍放入创作者区域,创作者节拍全画幅,产品节拍隐藏;用创作者原声(响度 -14 LUFS),可选压低音乐床,也能出纯音乐或静音母版。用本地 ffmpeg。
howto.when: 当你做分屏、屏幕插入等创作者叠在产品上的格式,并已备好 footage-cutlist 的图层与 create-creator-takes-h3 的创作者片段时使用。

say.text: 用 layer.mp4、节拍表和 creator.mp4 合成成片
say.note: 按节拍合成并输出成片

say.text: 加 --music 与 --music-db -20,音乐在人声下压低
say.note: 音乐作为被压低的声音床

say.text: --audio none 出一版静音母版,字幕之后再烧

howto.what_en: It composites a creator track into a product layer per beat: creator's zone on split beats, full frame on creator beats, hidden on product beats. Voice at -14 LUFS with optional ducked music; music-only or silent masters. Local ffmpeg.
howto.when_en: Use it for split-screen, screen-insert and other creator-over-product formats, once you have a footage-cutlist layer and a create-creator-takes-h3 creator track.

say_en.text: Composite layer.mp4, cutlist.aligned.json and creator.mp4 into reel.mp4
Add --music bed.mp3 --music-db -20 to duck music under the voice
say_en.note: Music is sidechained under the voice

say_en.text: Render a silent master with --audio none, then burn captions
